novena.title: True Faith
novena.opening: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
novena.invocation: O wonder-working Saint Rita, look upon me with your compassionate eyes, as I suffer and weep. See my bleeding heart surrounded by thorns. Look upon my eyes, Saint Rita: may they weep no more, for I have shed many tears!
main_prayer: I am weary and discouraged. I am even tired of praying. Should I give up amid the troubles of my life?
Come, O Saint Rita, come quickly and help me. Do Christians not call you the saint of impossible causes and the advocate of those who have lost hope?
Show the greatness of that name by obtaining from God all that I ask of you (here, name the intention you wish to present to God through Saint Rita).
Everyone praises your holiness. Everyone tells of the wonders and miracles God works through you. Should I alone be rejected and disappointed because you have not heard me? No.
Pray to the Lord Jesus for mercy and help in my distress and trouble. Through your intercession, O Saint Rita, may I receive what my heart longs for.
novena.personal_intention_instruction: Here, name the intention you wish to present to God through Saint Rita.
praises: Everyone tells of the wonders and miracles God works through you.
miracles_list: May fever, sores, and plague disappear.
May the causes of every illness disappear.
May demons and anger depart.
You help the blind, deaf, mute, and lame.
Children pray fervently.
The dead are restored to life.
Lightning, earthquakes, and fire have no power.
Every trap, great danger, and threat disappears.
acclamations: Spain proclaims you the saint of impossible causes.
novena.doxology: To God most holy and to His Son be praise, glory, and honour, through the ages of eternal love.

leader_response.kiongozi: You have marked your servant Rita, O Lord.
leader_response.wote: With the seal of love and suffering.

novena.closing_prayer: O God, who graciously crowned Saint Rita with grace, so that she loved her enemies and bore in her heart and on her brow the marks of love and suffering, grant us through her intercession the grace to forgive our enemies and meditate on the sufferings of Your Passion. May we receive the reward promised to the meek and those who suffer. You live and reign for ever and ever. Amen.
novena.extra_note: The Litany of Saint Rita of Cascia is found at the end of all the prayers.

novena.title: Patience in Suffering
novena.opening: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
novena.invocation: O wonder-working Saint Rita of Cascia, I see that the path of your life was filled with trials and piercing thorns, which I fear wounded your heart deeply. O Rita, true witness of great sorrow, who tasted the bitter cup drop by drop until it was drained. I think of your weary heart. I turn to you and ask God through your intercession (here, name the intention you wish to present to God through Saint Rita).
main_prayer: You know what it means to have a heart that bleeds; you also know the agony of the soul.
You were deeply wounded and suffered greatly. Through those sufferings, I ask you to help me in my troubles.
Is it not true that, in this difficult hour, our Lord Jesus has opened a way to grace through miracles that people may ask of you with hope and receive through your intercession?
O beloved Saint, look upon the wounded soul that weeps and grieves before you.
I trust in you, O Saint Rita. Pray to Jesus in heaven for me, that through your powerful intercession I may receive all that I ask of God.

novena.title: Peace and Reconciliation
novena.opening: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
novena.invocation: I look around for a place of rest, but find none; sorrow clouds my eyes. The hopes of this world cannot gladden my grieving heart, and I feel utterly lost. Yet you, beloved Saint Rita, shine like a bright star among the strength and pillars of the Catholic Church. I know you light my dark path and encourage my sorrowful heart. I trust you and eagerly await what I ask (here, name your intention to God through Saint Rita).
main_prayer: Carry my petition to Jesus on the Cross.
I remember your difficult years, when in obedience you married a man who tormented you and even threatened your life.
Yet you loved him deeply, and when he died, you mourned him with great sorrow.
With heroic generosity, you offered your sons to God, praying that they would not be stained by sin.
Pray to God for me; this was the agony of your heart.
Through the sufferings our Lord Jesus Christ permitted you to endure and the many trials and sacrifices you offered, pray that I may receive the petition I await with longing.

novena.title: Gentleness and Humility
novena.opening: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
novena.invocation: O Saint of impossible causes and advocate of those who have lost hope: these are titles filled with hope for souls tested by sorrow. O Saint Rita of Cascia, when we find ourselves alone, surrounded by sadness and death, you come like a gardener from heaven, bringing hope and living water to our dried-up hearts.
main_prayer: O hope of my heart, I have withered beneath the weight of sorrow. Misfortune burdens me, fear overwhelms me, and I do not know where to find the help I need.
Good Rita, I trust and rely on you. I come with confidence that you will hear me.
Through the power of your intercession before God’s throne, I hope to be heard in my petition (here, name your intention to God through Saint Rita).
Show yourself once more as powerful and compassionate.
Prove to me that you are truly, as your followers proclaim, the saint of impossible causes and advocate of those who have lost hope.

novena.title: True Forgiveness
novena.opening: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
novena.invocation: O beloved spouse of Jesus, Saint Rita of Cascia, I come to you again and kneel at your feet. Your goodness draws me, a soul troubled and burdened. You see how the hardships of this world have crushed my heart. I can no longer find a smile; dark doubts have overtaken my soul. My faith has faltered, and despair looms before me like death.
main_prayer: Beloved Saint, show me what to do in these frightening circumstances.
Advise me: to whom can I turn in this dangerous moment of my life?
If you truly are the saint of every hopeless situation, come and help me, for I feel lost.
I come to you, who always show compassion to those who suffer.
I come for your help. Will you not have mercy on my condition?

Saint Rita, I know how good you are. That is why I place myself entirely in your hands, trusting you to present to Jesus the petition I make in faith (here, name your intention to God through Saint Rita).

novena.title: Love for Others
novena.opening: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
novena.invocation: I know that my sins have clouded my prayers, keeping them from reaching your throne. My sins have brought great sorrow upon me. I do not dare raise my voice to Jesus, for I have often failed to value His mercy. Now I see His great power and justice; His just hand is turned toward me. I know I do not deserve His forgiveness, and sorrow weighs heavily on me. Without hope, I grieve for my sins. Tell me, Saint Rita, should I keep despairing? No. Our Lord Jesus Christ chose you as a powerful advocate to ask Him to forgive my grave faults and grant me a sincere resolve not to sin again.
main_prayer: With this firm resolve of my lips and heart, I turn to you.
O wonder-working Saint, ask the Lord Jesus for the graces I need now (here, name your intention to God through Saint Rita).
In this hour of deep weariness, sorrow, and loneliness, your word to Jesus will open His heart to mercy and forgiveness. Speak, and Jesus will hear you.

novena.title: Persevering Prayer
novena.opening: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
novena.invocation: Beloved Rita, whose life knew sorrow, turn your compassionate face toward me in my pain. May my prayers, weariness, and faltering steps reach your gentle heart, so that it may be opened to me. May the compassion you showed your neighbors, your words of peace and comfort, and your holy counsel draw me toward you in heaven, where you intercede for all who have lost hope.
main_prayer: Before your great miracles, death retreats; the blind receive sight, the lame stand, the paralyzed are healed, and infirmities of body and soul are overcome.
Am I the only one who will not be comforted through your intercession? I cannot believe it. Yes, I firmly trust in your care and intercession before God’s throne.
I have great hope that I will receive peace of heart, calm, and the grace for which I ask (here, name your intention to God through Saint Rita).

novena.title: Faithfulness to God
novena.opening: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
novena.invocation: O holy image of the glorious Cross, when I see you bowed before the Lord’s sacred feet and contemplate your brow wounded by a thorn from the crown of your beloved spouse, Jesus Christ, my faith in you blossoms wonderfully. You are God’s chosen servant. He gave you the mark of His kingdom, sanctified you, and made you wholly His own.
main_prayer: I was not wrong to place all my trust in you and to put myself beneath your compassionate protection. Now is the time to help me, for you know my needs and the help I seek.

I believe my prayer to you, beloved mother, will not be in vain. You work wonders and are a heavenly benefactor, trusted by all. By your love for Jesus Christ our Saviour, I beg you to intercede for the grace I seek (here, name your intention to God through Saint Rita).
God refuses you nothing. Through your intercession, miracles are worked and special graces are received. With all my heart and sincere hope, I wait for what I have asked of the Lord God.

novena.title: Unfailing Hope
novena.opening: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
novena.invocation: I come before you, Saint Rita, on the final day of this holy novena. In this difficult and unsettled time of my life, I feel my heart beating with concern. I believe the Lord will grant my petition through your holy intercession. But if it is not granted, I cry out for your mercy and comfort. Do not let me leave without your consolation.
main_prayer: Saint Rita, comfort me through the suffering you endured on earth and in the solitude of prayer. Comfort me through your generosity toward those in need; hear me through your great love for our Lord Jesus Christ and His most pure mother, the Blessed Virgin Mary.
Through the merit of the holy thorn our Lord Jesus Christ granted you, help and favour me.

This is my final appeal to you, mother and saint of impossible causes, advocate of those who have lost hope. Reveal your true light, and ask God to grant what I seek (here, name your intention to God through Saint Rita).

With your help, I intend to turn from my sinful ways and become a witness to God’s power and the beauty of heaven. I also promise to visit your place of solitude in Cascia, or your image, to join you in worship and thanksgiving for the heavenly graces I have received through the intercession of our dear Saviour Jesus Christ.
